title: 裸眼3D
prompt:
[Visual Style: Chromostereopsis Vector Art]
Generate a flat, 2D graphical poster designed to create a "naked eye 3D" optical illusion using color depth.
Key Rule: Use ONLY three specific colors: Pure High-Saturation Red (#FF0000), Pure Electric Blue (#0000FF), and Pitch Black (#000000). No gradients, no shading, no shadows.

[Foreground Subject: The Red Layer]
In the foreground, draw an anime-style girl with silver twin-tails and an eye patch.
Pose: Extreme foreshortening logic. She is viewed from a high angle (top-down), looking up. She is reaching her right hand aggressively toward the viewer. The hand should appear massive and exaggerated in size, taking up a large portion of the frame.
Rendering: The girl is rendered entirely as a flat Pure Red silhouette and line art. She holds a spider lily (also flat Red). Every detail of the character is flattened into red vector shapes.

[Background: The Blue Layer]
Behind the girl, fill the background with a dense grid of cybernetic typography, HUD numbers (like "01", "WARNING"), and Japanese kanji text.
Rendering: All text and background elements are Pure Electric Blue set against a Pitch Black void.

[Composition Logic]
The Red character must physically overlap and block the Blue background text.
Because the Red is superimposed on the Blue against Black, it should create a vibrating visual depth effect. The image must look like a high-contrast screen print, not a 3D render.
